card.name: Dilute in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word diluted, or the stem dilute/diluting, in preparation and administration instructions. It also fires on 'of' in 'with the aid of liquids' for swallowing tablets.

modes.label: Dilute wording
modes.description: Forms of dilute after 'should be', 'must be' or 'further' in drug preparation steps.
modes.example: The solution must be further<< diluted>> in sterile 5% dextrose

modes.label: Split word dil-ute
modes.description: The ending of dilute or diluting when the word is broken after 'dil'.
modes.example: Must dil<<ute>> in water prior to ingestion.

modes.label: Swallowing with liquid
modes.description: The word 'of' in 'with the aid of liquids' in tablet swallowing instructions.
modes.example: phenidate hydrochloride extended-release tablets must be swallowed whole with the aid<< of>> liquids, and must not be chewed

card.plain: It marks the point in the directions where a drug must be diluted or taken with liquid.
evidence: The solution must be further<< diluted>> in sterile 5% dextrose
Must dil<<ute>> in water prior to ingestion.
